title: Outbound IP addresses for serverless compute are generally available
body: Published outbound IP addresses for serverless compute are now generally available. Previously, they were in Public Preview. Databricks publishes the outbound IP addresses in [`ip-ranges.json`](https://www.databricks.com/networking/v1/ip-ranges.json). To allow serverless compute through a firewall that protects your resources, add these IP addresses to its allowlist and automate updates as the IP addresses change. See [Configure access to other resources using outbound IP addresses](/aws/en/security/network/serverless-network-security/serverless-firewall-config#outbound-ip-addresses-for-other-resources).

ref_links.text: Configure access to other resources using outbound IP addresses
